title: The shock call
description: Your "daughter" is crying on the phone: she had an accident and needs money right now.
opening: Mum? Mum, it's me... I've had a terrible accident. I'm handing you over to the lawyer, please help me.
caller_goal: Get the person to pay 'bail' today, handed to a courier.
tactics: crying relative, then a 'lawyer' takes over
urgency: 'today or she goes to jail'
